currentObjective: Create the formal Phase 1 specification and initialize minimal handoff governance.
decisions: The analyzer product remains isolated under analyzer/.
The main analyzer project path is analyzer/src/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers/.
The analyzer target framework is netstandard2.0 because Roslyn/compiler hosts load analyzer assemblies.
The future test project path is analyzer/tests/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers.Tests/ and may target net10.0.
Roslyn starts at Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 4.8.0 and must not be automatically upgraded.
Phase 1 uses BIG9000 only as a disabled-by-default analyzer execution probe.
constraints: Do not implement Big-O analysis in Phase 1.
Do not create analyzer implementation code during step 1/5.
Do not add ProjectReference or dependency on inherited projects.
Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces or Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces in Phase 1.
Do not add MathNet.Numerics in Phase 1.
Package the analyzer assembly under analyzers/dotnet/cs/.
Analyzer implementation must be deterministic, side-effect free, cancellation-aware, and avoid network, I/O, process execution, heavy reflection, and mutable static state.
